-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Bubble Refresher.png  |title= Bubble Magic |kanji= 泡魔法 |romaji= Awa Mahō |english= Bubble Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Paplo Espuma }} {{Nihongo|Bubble Magic|泡魔法|Awa Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate bubbles. It is derived from the Water Magic attribute.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate bubbles at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.{{Clr}}
